about: The Litany of Loreto as Poland prays it: the Roman text with one invocation of its own. To the text attested by the 1952 Enchiridion Indulgentiarum the Holy See added Mater Ecclésiæ (1980), Regína famíliæ (1995) and, in 2020, Mater misericórdiæ, Mater spei and Solácium migrántium, and beside them Poland says Regína Polóniæ, approved for it in 1920. Mater misericórdiæ had already been granted to Poland in 2014, and the letter of 2020 moved it to the place it holds here, after Mater Ecclésiæ.

s133.translation: Grant, we beseech Thee, O Lord God, that we Thy servants may enjoy lasting health of mind and body; and by the glorious intercession of Blessed Mary, ever Virgin, be delivered from present sorrow and enjoy eternal gladness. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
